# Enteha Group (گروه فنی مهندسی انتها)

> Enteha Group (گروه فنی مهندسی انتها) is a mechanical engineering design-and-build group based in Tehran and Isfahan, Iran; it is not related to other businesses that use the word “Enteha” (انتها, “end”) in their names. It designs and builds special-purpose machines, test rigs and industrial robots, automates production lines, and manufactures industrial parts to drawing, for clients across Iran. One-off orders are accepted and quotes are free (usually within 1–2 weeks).

> گروه فنی مهندسی انتها یک گروه طراحی و ساخت مهندسی مکانیک در تهران و اصفهان است و با کسب‌وکارهای دیگری که واژه‌ی «انتها» در نامشان است ارتباطی ندارد.

## Key facts

- Based in Tehran and Isfahan, Iran; serves clients across Iran. Website: https://entehagroup.github.io/
- Core team: Hassan Nasiri Khonsari (Technical & Design Director), Alireza Pirhaji (Manufacturing & Quality Lead), Seyed Mostafa Banihashemi (Project & R&D Lead); degrees from Sharif University of Technology, IUST, K. N. Toosi University and Tarbiat Modares University; plus a network of partner workshops and specialists.
- Scope: requirements, concept and detailed design, engineering analysis (FEA), fabrication, assembly, quality control and commissioning. The engineer who designs a machine also supervises its fabrication and assembly.
- Track record: 80 postal sorting robots built for Iran Post (50 for Tehran, 30 for Kermanshah, 2020–2025), with a third-generation design produced as a 200-unit series; a 6-DOF knee prosthesis test rig to ASTM F1223, the first of its kind in Iran (2021); five industrial FDM 3D printers up to 500 × 500 × 400 mm (2020–2023); a fleet of seven waiter robots (2021); a dual-purpose CNC with a ~100 × 100 cm bed (2023).
- Past work ranges from machines of 10–250 kg to structures of about 1–2 tonnes.
- Typical timelines: 1–2 weeks to about a year; a simple special-purpose machine takes 1–2 months of design and 1–2 months of fabrication. Quotes are free and take 1–2 weeks.
- Automation: Delta and Siemens PLC, HMI, servo and stepper motion control, weighing and measurement, control cabinets, integration with existing equipment.
- Parts: CNC machining, laser cutting, bending and rolling, welded structures in steel and 316 stainless, pressure vessels and enclosures, plastic injection moulds, dimensional and weld inspection (GD&T), reverse engineering; drawings accepted in any format.
- Support: faults in machines Enteha designed and built are fixed for 2 months after delivery; longer warranty, repairs and upgrades by contract.
- Industries: medical and dental devices, postal and logistics, additive manufacturing, universities and research centres, service robotics.
- Member awards: Hassan Nasiri Khonsari received the 64th Alborz Elite Prize (2026) and took 2nd place at the 24th Khwarizmi Youth Festival (Iranian year 1401) for the knee prosthesis test rig. The postal sorting robots team earned 2nd place at the 26th Khwarizmi Youth Festival, best design at the 4th Iran Industrial Design Festival, and top startup at Sharif Science & Technology Park, all in 2024.
- Publication: “Frictional behavior between bone and additively manufactured Ti6Al4V implants is affected by bone density and surface texture under varying loads”, Scientific Reports, 2025 (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25586-0).

## Projects

- [Postal sorting robots](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/postal-sorting-robots.html): 80 autonomous parcel-sorting robots built for Iran Post; the third-generation design went into production as a 200-unit series.
- [Knee prosthesis constraint & stability test rig](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/knee-prosthesis-test-rig.html): A six-degree-of-freedom test rig for total knee prostheses to ASTM F1223 — the first of its kind in Iran.
- [CNC spinning of kettle bodies](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/cnc-kettle-spinning.html): Step-by-step forming toolpaths designed in SolidCAM and tested on the workshop's CNC machine, to automate kettle-body forming that used to be done by hand.
- [DMD powder feeder](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/dmd-powder-feeder.html): A powder feeder for laser direct metal deposition, controlling the feed rate between 1 and 100 g/min.
- [Industrial FDM 3D printers](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/industrial-3d-printers.html): Five FDM printers designed and built from scratch, up to an industrial machine with a 500 × 500 × 400 mm build volume.
- [Rail-guided platform over a test pool](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/rail-guided-test-platform.html): A rail-guided platform and cabin over a water-treatment test pool: structural design, fabrication and on-site installation.
- [Cable-driven rehabilitation robot](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/cable-rehabilitation-robot.html): A cable-driven robot to improve postural alignment in children with cerebral palsy: design, fabrication and control.
- [Waiter robots](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/waiter-robots.html): A fleet of seven food delivery and serving robots that stay stable on uneven restaurant floors.
- [Dual-purpose industrial CNC](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/dual-purpose-cnc.html): A modular CNC with a bed of about 100 × 100 cm for wood and light metals that becomes a 3D printer with a head swap.
- [Dental aligners & veneers](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/dental-aligners.html): Orthodontic aligners and removable dental veneers produced by resin (DLP) 3D printing.
- [Conveyor-belt FDM 3D printer](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/conveyor-3d-printer.html): An FDM printer with a conveyor-belt bed for continuous printing of long parts and batches.
- [Plastic injection mould](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/injection-mould.html): Design and machining of a plastic injection mould.
- [Jet engine cutaway model](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/jet-engine-model.html): A 3D-printed cutaway model of a jet engine for display and teaching.
- [Cable-driven drawing robot](https://entehagroup.github.io/projects/cable-drawing-robot.html): A cable-driven drawing robot that turns any photo into a line drawing and draws it on canvas.
